I will examine v1.go, connect_handler.go, and connect_services.go to identify the two protocols and their registration files.

Connect appears in connect_handler.go and connect_services.go. The second protocol may be gRPC-Gateway in v1.go, or native gRPC. I will check v1.go fully to confirm.

One protocol is Connect, registered in connect_handler.go via apiv1connect.

The second protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP). It is registered in v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. Connect wrapping happens in connect_services.go through ConnectServiceHandler methods that wrap APIV1Service.

The generated gRPC-Gateway code lives in proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go. APIV1Service embeds UnimplementedMemoServiceServer, so the gateway calls it directly without extra wrapping. Connect wrapping still happens in connect_services.go.

I am checking whether native gRPC is also served, since connect_handler.go mentions both protocols but v1.go may only register the gateway handler.

The two protocols are Connect and gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/REST). No native gRPC server exists.

Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go, server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go

v1.go orchestrates both protocols. connect_handler.go registers the handler via NewMemoServiceHandler. connect_services.go wraps the service. APIV1Service implements gRPC-Gateway directly without a separate wrapper.

q19.

Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go, server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go  
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go

`MemoService` is exposed over **Connect** and **gRPC-Gateway** (HTTP/REST). Both are wired in `RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`.

**Connect** — handler registration in `connect_handler.go`, method wrapping in `connect_services.go`:

```40:40:server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go
		wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)),
```

`ConnectServiceHandler` methods in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` delegate to `APIV1Service` (e.g. `ListMemos`, `CreateMemo`).

**gRPC-Gateway** — registered directly on `APIV1Service` in `v1.go`:

```108:110:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
	if err := v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s); err != nil {
		return err
	}
```

HTTP routes come from the generated gateway code in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`; registration happens in `v1.go`. There is no separate native gRPC server for `MemoService` in this repo.
